entry: DECL-P4-24 mesh holes and edges, 20260701183124-w010-027 (2.4 um), strip-a r0-r8 x c0-c19
viewing: No image, tile or CT pixel was viewed or described; CT values were streamed as numbers (single voxels and 1-D normal profiles) and discarded.
item_e_label: not specific beyond about 1 mm (DECL-P4-24-A1 item 4; holes_extrap_check.json: straight extrapolation drifts 137-250 um at 2 mm vs ~165 um sheet spacing)
item_e_reference_behaviour: The c0-c8 reference edge tiles show the same behaviour (r0: 35-78 % of rays with a peak at 2 mm; r8: 70-95 %), so the 22 (e) flags (every r0 and r8 tile of c9-c19) do not distinguish the title zone. r8 keeps peaks at 5 mm (80-95 %) in both reference and compared tiles: the mesh's lower edge (z ~ 29 mm) is not the end of papyrus. r0 has ~0 at 5 mm (zeroed/masked data above the roll end).

summary_flags.a_holes: none: 0 interior holes in the whole grid; invalid fractions within the reference range
summary_flags.b_zero_or_missing: none outside the reference (max 0.0025 in both)

verdict: No interior mesh holes anywhere in w010-027 (0 in the whole grid), and no missing/zero surface-volume input beyond the reference. Specific HOLE-FLAGs in the title zone come from (c) and (d) only: (c) stretched/crushed official flattening in r6_c15, r6_c18, r7_c16 (0.56-0.74 % of triangles vs reference max 0.44 %) - the same r6-r7 x c15-c18 patch where the L10 audit found self-intersections and close approaches; (d) mesh off the papyrus in r2_c19 (37.5 % of 40 vertices without a sheet peak) and r5_c18 (22.5 %; reference max 20 %). The 22 (e) flags (all r0 and r8 tiles, c9-c19) are from the declared straight test, which is not specific beyond about 1 mm and behaves the same in the reference; the sheet-following (e2) test failed its own validation on known mesh (v1 2.3 %, v2 12 % of columns vs >= 80 % required) and is not applied.

e2.rule: DECL-P4-24-A1 item 2: VALID iff >= 80 % of columns reach 2 mm with offset <= 30 um

v2_disclosed_variant.note: P_MIN2 evaluated to 0.0 (median step-0 prominence was 0), so v2 ran without a prominence threshold, its most permissive setting; it still fails.

e2.outcome: NOT VALID (both variants): (e2) is not applied beyond the edge; item (e) stays 'not specific beyond about 1 mm'. The sheet cannot be followed reliably even inside the known mesh with a +-60 um re-centring at 0.1 mm steps (most rays stop on a >40 um re-centre jump), so whether the papyrus continues beyond the mesh edges remains unmeasured by this method.
